findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
findings.evidence: User A requested order 1002, owned by User B, and received HTTP 200 with User B's order data.
findings.expected_result: HTTP 403 or HTTP 404 because order 1002 is not owned by User A.
findings.actual_result: HTTP 200 with another user's order data.
findings.remediation: Verify resource ownership for every object ID before reading, updating, or deleting it.

findings.title: Excessive Data Exposure
findings.evidence: The response included sensitive field(s): internalNotes, paymentReference
findings.expected_result: A normal user response should omit internal or secret fields.
findings.actual_result: Sensitive fields were returned in the API response.
findings.remediation: Return an allowlisted response DTO for this endpoint and exclude internal notes, payment references, tokens, and secrets.

findings.title: Possible Missing Rate Limiting
findings.evidence: All 5 controlled sandbox requests succeeded without a limiting response.
findings.expected_result: A sensitive endpoint should enforce a documented rate limit.
findings.actual_result: No limiting response was observed during the safe low-volume probe.
findings.remediation: Add endpoint-appropriate rate limiting and return HTTP 429 when the threshold is exceeded.
